item.title: dovecot_2_3: mark insecure
item.description:
This marks pkgs.dovecot_2_3 and pkgs.dovecot_pigeonhole_0_5 as insecure. They are both EOL upstream and received no security update since 2024-08. There's at least 16 CVEs for it on NVD so far, one of which rated critical.

We already have 2.4 in nixpkgs, so the messages point users to upgrade to it. This insecure mark might be worth a backport to nixos 26.05 as well.

item.title: php86: 8.6.0RC4 -> 8.6.0
item.description:
PHP 8.6.0 GA: https://www.php.net/releases/8_6_0.php Changes: https://github.com/php/php-src/blob/php-8.6.0/NEWS

php86 now uses the default php.net/distributions tarball like the other PHP versions, so the pre-release phpSrc = fetchurl { ... } override and the now-unused fetchurl argument are removed (mkPhp keeps its phpSrc option for the next pre-release cycle).

The hash matches the official sha256 in the php.net releases JSON, and the tarball's GPG signature (Matteo Beccati, 016895DE9A475111D537A6E69134FF30BC5A99B5) verifies against php-keyring.gpg.

Compared to RC4, this also brings the bundled uriparser 1.0.3 (CVE-2026-48841, from RC5) and the security fixes released today:
